# Task Summary

Implement `PK-009 Metadata And Sharing` using only the requested chunk and its explicit dependencies from `tmp/pokeatlas-feature-chunks.md`: `PK-001 Landing Experience` and `PK-004 Pokemon Detail Page`.

The goal is to make PokeAtlas look intentional when opened directly, indexed by search engines, or shared in chat and social contexts. The chunk covers stronger titles and descriptions, share-friendly Pokemon detail pages, social preview image support for detail content, and file-based crawl support through sitemap and robots metadata routes.

# Affected Area Summary

- `src/app/layout.tsx`
  - Establish the shared metadata foundation for the app.
- `src/app/page.tsx`
  - Add route-specific metadata for the landing page.
- `src/app/pokedex/page.tsx`
  - Optionally strengthen browse metadata as part of the same polish pass.
- `src/app/pokedex/[pokemon]/page.tsx`
  - Expand canonical detail metadata beyond title and description.
- `src/app/pokedex/[pokemon]/opengraph-image.tsx`
  - Generate share-friendly social preview images for Pokemon detail pages.
- `src/app/robots.ts`
  - Add file-based crawl directives.
- `src/app/sitemap.ts`
  - Add file-based sitemap generation for canonical pages only.
- optional shared metadata helper under `src/lib/*`
  - Centralize canonical URL and metadata composition if repetition becomes non-trivial.

# Implementation Approach

Treat `PK-009` as a metadata and crawl-surface improvement layered on top of the existing routes, not as a route-architecture change.

The recommended implementation is:

- strengthen root metadata in `src/app/layout.tsx`
- add route metadata for `/`
- keep `/pokedex` metadata coherent with the rest of the app while staying secondary to home/detail scope
- expand `/pokedex/[pokemon]` metadata to include:
  - stronger title and description
  - canonical URL
  - Open Graph fields
  - Twitter card fields
  - share image reference
- create `src/app/pokedex/[pokemon]/opengraph-image.tsx` for generated detail social previews
- create `src/app/robots.ts`
- create `src/app/sitemap.ts`

What stays out of scope:

- route cleanup unrelated to metadata, including removing the stale `src/app/pokedex/[slug]` tree
- indexing or share treatment for intercepted modal routes under `src/app/pokedex/@modal/*`
- large marketing-copy rewrites beyond what metadata needs
- persistence, analytics, or share-state features

# Architecture Notes

- Metadata foundation:
  - Add `metadataBase` in `src/app/layout.tsx`.
  - Add a title template and stronger global defaults for Open Graph, Twitter, and robots metadata.
- Canonical URL source:
  - Prefer an env-driven site URL with a safe production-shaped fallback.
  - The plan should not block on deployment plumbing if the env var is absent locally.
- Detail metadata strategy:
  - Keep `generateMetadata` in `src/app/pokedex/[pokemon]/page.tsx`.
  - Reuse the existing normalized detail fetch path rather than introducing a second data source.
  - Generate canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, and alternate metadata from normalized detail data.
- Social image strategy:
  - Prefer generated OG images via `opengraph-image.tsx` for Pokemon detail pages.
  - Use normalized detail content plus existing artwork URLs as image input.
  - Allow a metadata fallback to official artwork only if generated output proves runtime-sensitive during implementation.
- Sitemap strategy:
  - Include only canonical routes:
    - `/`
    - `/pokedex`
    - `/team-builder`
    - canonical Pokemon detail pages under `/pokedex/[pokemon]`
  - Exclude intercepted modal routes and any stale route tree from sitemap output.
- Robots strategy:
  - Allow indexing for public routes.
  - Reference the generated sitemap.
- Risk note:
  - `src/app/pokedex/[slug]` still exists and may confuse future canonical handling. Treat it as a follow-up cleanup risk, not as part of `PK-009`.

# Open Decisions

- Canonical URL source:
  - Option A: environment variable with a hardcoded fallback
  - Option B: environment variable only
  - Recommendation: Option A, because metadata, sitemap, and robots should remain coherent in local and preview environments without blocking implementation.
- Detail social image strategy:
  - Option A: generated OG images via `src/app/pokedex/[pokemon]/opengraph-image.tsx`
  - Option B: remote official artwork only
  - Recommendation: Option A, because the chunk explicitly calls for social preview images and generated output gives PokeAtlas an intentional share surface instead of a raw asset link.
- Browse-route metadata depth:
  - Option A: strengthen `/pokedex` metadata as part of `PK-009`
  - Option B: leave `/pokedex` metadata unchanged and focus only on home/detail
  - Recommendation: Option A, because it is low-cost, consistent with the chunk’s polish goal, and does not expand architecture.
